nodes.description: A heavy anchor to stop your boat drifting.

The Animal Fence is a sturdy wooden fence for penning animals, and you can craft it from your inventory for 250 wood with no workbench needed. It decays in 8 hours outside and 80 hours inside, so a pen indoors saves you from replacing it as often. If you have a spare, a Green Recycler gives back 125 wood.
A gate for accessing your animal pen.
A wooden barricade with barbed wire, made of Wood and Metal Fragments. The barbed wire causes damage and will also slow player movement.

The Beancan Grenade is an unreliable explosive with a different fuse length on each one, and its main job is going into satchel charges. Craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 60 gunpowder and 20 metal frags, after researching it for 40 [scrap](/items/scrap). It's used in 1 recipe, the Satchel Charge, which takes 4. Elite crates and heavy scientists drop pairs, but rarely. A Green Recycler also gets you 2 back from a satchel.

A bed gives you a respawn point usable far more often than a [sleeping bag](/items/sleeping-bag), but it has to be placed inside a building. To make a bed in Rust, craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 60 cloth, 100 metal frags and 2 [sewing kits](/items/sewing-kit). Research costs 40 [scrap](/items/scrap), or 5 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total on the tech tree. Crate drops are rare. A Green Recycler returns 30 cloth, 50 frags and a sewing kit.

The Bee Grenade, or beenade, is a fragile glass jar that breaks on impact and sets bees on the nearest player, so watch where you throw it. Craft one at a tier 1 workbench for 1 [Beehive Nucleus](/items/beehive-nucleus) and 30 cloth. Research is 20 [scrap](/items/scrap), or 5 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total on the tech tree. Crate and scientist drops are rare, around 1% at best. It's used in 1 recipe, the [Bee Catapult Bomb](/items/bee-catapult-bomb).

The Beehive is where you raise bees. Drop a nucleus inside and they start producing [honeycomb](/items/honeycomb), faster if the bees are happy. Craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 300 wood and 1 [sheet metal](/items/sheet-metal); it's 20 scrap to research or 4 blueprint fragments total down the tech tree after the [chicken coop](/items/chicken-coop). Loot drops are rare, topping out at 1.11% from underwater advanced crates. A Green Recycler returns 150 wood and a 50% shot at sheet metal.
A wooly hat, offering some basic protection from damage and cold for your head.
Binoculars allowing you to see objects at great length.

The Biofuel Generator, or bio generator, is a big pot that turns food and other organic matter into low grade fuel, not power: it actually uses 5 rW. Load its 3 input slots and it makes up to 5 fuel a minute, needing a 10-second stir every 30 minutes at full load. Craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 250 frags and 150 wood, 40 [scrap](/items/scrap) to research or 5 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) through the tech tree.
A boat plan. You can use this to craft boats - right click when equipped for more options.

Deploy the Boat Building Station on the water for a stable workspace to build or edit your floating wooden boat. Craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 200 wood and 1 [tarp](/items/tarp), after researching it for 40 scrap or unlocking it past the [kayak](/items/kayak) for 4 blueprint fragments total. To build a boat you also need the [Boat Building Plan](/items/boat-building-plan), which crafts for 20 wood and costs 5 blueprint fragments total on the tech tree. Tropical Islands already have a station placed.
A Bucket Helmet. It provides a level of regional protection from inflicted damage.

The Cannon is a heavy boat mount with a short fuse, shaky accuracy and big damage, firing cannonballs. A cannonball does 61 damage to boat parts, so a [Boat Hull](/building/boat-hull-square) goes down in 2 and every other piece in 1, while an enemy Cannon takes 7 at 160 each. Bases are a different story: a [stone wall](/building/stone-wall) takes 715. Craft the Cannon at a tier 1 workbench for 100 wood and 200 frags after researching it for 20 [scrap](/items/scrap).
Round solid ammo for the cannon

The chainlink fence slots into a wall frame, twig through armored. Craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 75 frags, with research at 20 [scrap](/items/scrap) or 6 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total down the tech tree, since crate and scientist drops are rare. To break a chain link fence, 1 C4, 1 rocket or 2 satchels does it, or 6 Beancan Grenades stuck to it. Melee works too, but takes over 8 minutes even with a Salvaged Hammer.
A Chainlink Fence Gate.
Every home needs a chair. A decorative item which provides comfort while seated.

The Chicken Coop is an enclosure for keeping [chickens](/world/chicken) around, and they lay more [eggs](/items/egg) with plenty of food, water and sunlight. Chickens spawn in temperate biomes in groups of 2-4, in spots like fields, forests, roadsides, riversides and lakesides. Craft the coop at a tier 1 workbench for 300 wood, 1 [rope](/items/rope) and 75 frags. Research costs 20 scrap, or 3 blueprint fragments total on the tech tree. It's only a rare drop from crates and scientists.
A table for managing clans.
Combat knife designed for close combat engagements, can attack while sprinting. Best in class at harvesting flesh.
A very powerful bow. Can only be fully drawn while stationary. Keep still for bonus damage and speed.

The Double Barrel Shotgun, or DB, fires two shots in quick succession before you need to reload. The cheapest scrap price is around 112 from the Floating City casino bar shopkeepers or the [Water Well shopkeeper](/world/water-well-npc) when they're stocked, while the [Outpost](/monument/outpost) and Floating City weapon shops sell it for 250. Craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 175 frags and 2 [metal pipes](/items/metal-pipe), with the blueprint at 100 scrap to research or 11 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) on the tech tree.

The Drop Box, or dropbox, mounts on a wall so players can put items in from outside your base, while the contents can only be taken from the rear. It has 16 slots. The simplest way to get one is 40 scrap at [Bandit Camp](/monument/bandit-camp), or craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 200 frags after researching one for 40 scrap or spending 9 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) on the tech tree. Loot is rare, 1.11% at best.
This allows you to craft and unlock electrical, water and industrial items
A fuel soaked arrow, ignite it by aiming.

The Flame Turret is an automated trap that runs on low grade fuel and sprays flames when triggered. Buy one for 250 scrap at [Outpost](/monument/outpost) or a Floating City weapons shop, or craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 200 frags, 2 [empty propane tanks](/items/empty-propane-tank) and 1 gear. To destroy one, it takes 5 thrown F1 grenades, 7 thrown Beancan Grenades, 34 explosive 5.56 rounds, 2 satchels or 1 C4.
Light up the night sky with this brand new red flare!
A floor grill must be placed in floor frames. Perfect for placing above a large furnace.
A floor grill must be placed in floor frames. Perfect for placing above a large furnace.
An extremely basic automatic firearm. Low damage and accuracy.
A Hatchet, useful for chopping trees and dismembering corpses.
A high wooden gate, allowing access in and out of your compound.

High external wooden walls are there to keep people off your property. Eight molotovs burn one down, 2 incendiary rockets or 2 C4 also do it, and F1 grenades are a joke at 118 stuck or 378 thrown. Once you've researched them for 100 [scrap](/items/scrap), craft them at a tier 1 workbench, where 4000 wood makes 3 walls. Finding them in loot is rare, with the best odds around 1% from [underwater advanced crates](/world/crate-underwater-advanced).
Armor for the Hot Air Balloon
A 6-meter by 3-meter wooden sign that you can write on.
A makeshift balaclava. Cost effective protection from the cold, but unremarkable at preventing melee and projectile damage.
A rugged jacket, will help keep you warm. High cold protection but incompatible with other chest attire.
An improvised wooden kayak. Seats two and requires a Paddle to operate.
A large planter with enough room to plant 9 seeds.
A 3-meter by 1.5-meter wooden sign that you can write on.
Long sleeve tshirt, versatile clothing for protection against damage and the elements.
A powerful 2-handed melee weapon, It's unique design makes it easier to hit your target when compared to other more traditional weapons.
A Mailbox that accepts notes. Only you can access the mail due to a one way slit.

The Medical Honey Bandage heals you or a teammate: left click for you, right click for them. It gives 8 health plus 6 over time and takes off 50 bleeding, 4 poison and 5 radiation. Most reliable buy is a Floating City Medical Shop, 3 for around 14 scrap. Otherwise craft one at a tier 1 workbench from 4 cloth and 2 Jars of Honey, after researching it for 20 scrap or unlocking it past the Bee Grenade for 6 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment).
Metal window bars made to fit a normal sized window.
A leather cap with a flashlight attached. It uses Low Grade Fuel and can be activated from the inventory.
A very accurate ranged weapon with a rotating barrel.

The Mixing Table runs 57 recipes: every tea, plus low grade fuel, gunpowder, [explosives](/items/explosives) and ammo, which need the blueprint. It won't give more gp, still 10, but costs 20 [charcoal](/items/charcoal) instead of 30. A [Cooking Workbench](/items/cooking-workbench) runs all of those plus bread and pies (81 in total), but needs tier 2. Craft one at tier 1 for 200 frags and 100 stones (40 scrap to research, 5 blueprint fragments on the tech tree) or pay 175 scrap at [Bandit Camp](/monument/bandit-camp) or Floating City.
A versatile melee weapon that can also be used to paddle a kayak.
A pair of pants, highly capable undergarment for your legs. Great all round protection from damage and the elements.
A Pickaxe, useful for gathering ore from rocks.

Pistol Bullets are the ammo for pistols and SMGs, and lose a little damage over long distances. To make them, craft at a tier 1 workbench: 10 frags and 5 [gun powder](/items/gun-powder) makes 4 bullets, and a [Mixing Table](/items/mixing-table) works the same way. Research costs 40 scrap, or 12 blueprint fragments through the tech tree. Floating City shopkeepers sell 20 for around 24 scrap when in stock, and [supply drops](/world/supply-drop), [cannon crates](/world/crate-cannons) and heavy scientists drop them often.
Crude boarding plank thrown together from ruined floorboards, watch out for splinters.
A basic wooden shield with added protection, keeps you safe but not for long. Usable with single handed weapons and tools.

The Revolver, or revo, is a standard eight-shot sidearm. Cheapest buy is the Casino Bar Shopkeeper at the Floating Cities or the [Water Well shopkeeper](/world/water-well-npc), around 102 scrap when they have it in stock, otherwise the weapons shops at [Outpost](/monument/outpost) and the Floating Cities sell it for 200 scrap. The blueprint is 40 scrap to research or 13 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total through the tech tree, then it's a tier 1 workbench craft for 1 [metal pipe](/items/metal-pipe), 25 cloth and 125 frags.
A makeshift riot Helmet. Great at deflecting melee attacks.
A decorative rug that can be placed on walls, floors, and ceilings. Provides comfort when in close proximity.
A decorative rug that can be placed on walls, floors, and ceilings. Provides comfort when in close proximity.

The Sail is what pushes your boat along, and you can put up to 10 per boat. One is slow, but more sails generate more speed. Craft one at a tier 1 workbench for 150 wood and a [tarp](/items/tarp), or buy it for 50 scrap from the [Boat Vendor](/world/boat-vendor) at any Floating City. Research costs 20 scrap, or 7 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total through the tech tree. In a Green Recycler you get 75 wood and a 50% shot at a tarp.
A powerful 2-handed melee weapon with high damage.

The Salvaged Hammer is a junk-built hammer, and crafting is the way to get one: 1 [metal pipe](/items/metal-pipe) and 50 frags at a tier 1 workbench. The blueprint costs 40 [scrap](/items/scrap) at a research table, or 1 [blueprint fragment](/items/blueprint-fragment) on the tech tree, where it needs nothing unlocked first. Drops are rare, about 1% from [underwater advanced crates](/world/crate-underwater-advanced) at best. In a Green Recycler you get 25 frags and a 50% chance at a metal pipe.
Shelves for item stacking
A powerful melee weapon made from a filed-down wrench. Great durability, good damage.
A protective barricade made out of Sand Bags. Deploy another one on top to build it higher, up to a sandbag pillbox.

The satchel charge is a small explosive built from beancan grenades, useful for blowing wood and [sheet metal doors](/items/sheet-metal-door). To make one you need a tier 1 workbench, 4 beancans, a [small stash](/items/small-stash) and a [rope](/items/rope). Each one comes to 480 sulfur, 720 charcoal and 80 frags, so 10 satchels cost 4800 sulfur. Research costs 100 scrap, or 15 blueprint fragments total on the tech tree. [Supply drops](/world/supply-drop) give 2-4 about half the time.
A smart casual shirt. Might make you look more trustworthy. Moderate clothing for protection against damage and the elements.
Trusty pair of shorts, may provide a breeze in undesired places. Worse than their full length counterparts with only basic protection from damage and the elements.

The Shotgun Trap is a motion-triggered trap you place near doorways and load with handmade shells as ammo. Buy one for 150 scrap at [Outpost](/monument/outpost) or Floating City, or craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 500 wood, 250 frags, 2 [gears](/items/gears) and 2 [rope](/items/rope). Loot drops are rare, 1.11% at best. To break one, use 5 thrown F1 Grenades, 7 thrown Beancan Grenades, 2 satchels, 1 C4, 1 HV rocket or a single machete.

The Siege Tower is a rolling raid tower, a siege machine that gives you cover and access to enemy bases. You can lock it with your own door and tow it with [horses](/world/horse). Craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 500 wood, 250 frags and 1 gear, after researching it for 20 [scrap](/items/scrap) or unlocking it for 10 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total on the tech tree. Crate and scientist drops are rare. Killing one takes 5 molotovs.
Deployable wooden ramp cobbled together from recycled doors, probably sturdy enough. Unfolds for boarding enemy vessels.
A metal trap that can injure or even kill people when stepped on. Can be picked up after been triggered.

The Snow Jacket is Rust's winter jacket, a thick high-vis layer for staying warm in any climate. Buy it for 20 scrap at the [Outpost](/monument/outpost) attire vendor or the Floating City attire shops. Crafting needs a tier 1 workbench, 60 cloth and a [sewing kit](/items/sewing-kit). Research costs 20 scrap, or 5 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total on the tech tree. [Supply drops](/world/supply-drop) often carry 1-4. It also has skins.
Significantly reduces the sound of gunfire, and completely removes any visible muzzle flash. Crudely made out of a soda can, this will only survive a few shots.
A speargun which can only be fired underwater. Excellent for hunting Sharks.
Ammunition for a speargun.
An interactive spinning wheel.

The Steering Wheel is the lockable helm for your [modular boat](/world/playerboat). To break a boat steering wheel, one C4, satchel, rocket or molotov does it, as do 2 thrown F1 grenades or 3 thrown beancans. Melee works too: a hatchet or salvaged axe takes it down in about 11 seconds, a jackhammer in 4. Craft one for 100 wood at a tier 1 workbench (research costs 20 scrap) or pay 50 scrap at the Floating City [Boat Vendor](/world/boat-vendor).
A protective barricade made out of Stones.
A stone fireplace to heat your home. Must be placed indoors and against a wall.
A tshirt, simple undergarment. Good protection from damage and the elements.
Every home needs a table. A decorative item which provides comfort when in close proximity.
A tank top, comes with free stains. Basic protection, but better than nothing.
A primitive perimeter alarm made from hanging tin cans. Clatters loudly when disturbed, alerting you to any trespassers. Can be rigged with grenades or other throwables.
A triangle planter with enough room to plant 4 seeds.

The Tuna Can Lamp is a makeshift wall light that takes low grade fuel. Cheapest way to get one is [Bandit Camp](/monument/bandit-camp) at 5 scrap, or craft it with no workbench from an [Empty Tuna Can](/items/empty-tuna-can), 20 wood and 10 low grade fuel. Research costs 20 scrap, or 3 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total on the tech tree. [Basic crates](/world/crate-basic) rarely drop it. A Green Recycler returns 10 wood and 5 low grade fuel, plus a 50% chance at the tuna can.
A high wooden watchtower with a ladder
A bucket for transporting water or other liquids.
A Shotgun. Fires a single round before reloading.
Attaches to a weapon. Provides user with a beam of light. Pressing F (default) to toggle light.
Wood shutters that you can open and close.
Wood insert for crafted clothes and armor, provides some extra protection from bullets and melee.
A wooden barricade. Will hurt players and animals that run into it.

The Wooden Barricade Cover is cheap cover for gun fights, crafted from 250 wood with no workbench needed. Get the blueprint for 20 [scrap](/items/scrap) at a research table or 3 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total through the tech tree at a tier 1 workbench. Loot drops are rare, with [basic crates](/world/crate-basic) the best at under 5%. Don't expect it to last: it decays rapidly outside building privilege, with timers of 15 minutes outside and 2.5 hours inside.
A set of spikes that will slow down and hurt anyone that walks over them.

A Wooden Ladder lets you climb walls in any base. To make one, craft it at a Workbench Level 1 for 300 wood and 3 [rope](/items/rope), after unlocking the blueprint for 100 [scrap](/items/scrap) at a research table or 3 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) on the tech tree. Basic jungle crates have a 42% chance of 1-3, but other loot drops are rare, around 1% or less. It's also an ingredient in all four [ladder hatches](/items/ladder-hatch).

The Wool Armor Insert is a clothing insert built for the cold, adding 24% cold protection along with 2% melee and 1% bullet and arrow protection. Craft it at a tier 1 workbench from 20 [wool](/items/wool), which you get by shearing [sheep](/world/sheep) for 10 at a time, regrowing every 5 minutes. Research costs 100 scrap, or 8 blueprint fragments total on the tech tree, where it comes after the [Wooden Armor Insert](/items/wooden-armor-insert). A Green Recycler gives back 10 wool.
